statement: Red bucket on the arcade Plinko has a 2% chance to give a premium red boat hat (Red Hat), released with the arcade clown.
Premium red hat was something to aim for so he promised chat he would farm it until he got it.
He spent $20 then $100 on Plinko balls and didn't get the red hat, then $2 more with no luck.
Lava gave him 2000 Plinko balls and he still did not get the red hat.
Spent in increments of $100, $200, $300 and $400 with no red hat drop.
He finally got the red hat after almost $800 spent on Plinko.
The red hat can't be sold for more money so it is not technically an NFT.
The red hat stats weren't even good; the chase was about the premise and goal rather than stats or cosmetic.
Compares the red hat chase to waiting for a 2% to 0.1% drop in other games.
Others claim to get the hat in one ball or in 100 balls; he says that is incredibly rare compared to his experience.
On the same day he got the red hat he also hit the Plinko jackpot.
He rolled about 8 hours of Plinko footage and spent approximately $800 to get the red hat.
